title: The AI Race No One Can Afford to Win
central_question: What happens when competition pushes frontier AI forward faster than institutions can understand, govern, or safely distribute its power?
audience_promise: A restrained, evidence-led cinematic investigation of why AI labs keep accelerating despite acknowledging serious risks, and why regulation can reduce danger while also concentrating control.
visual_language: premium cinematic video essay with real-world footage and primary evidence leading; restrained editorial graphics only when factually necessary
